metadata.target_conclusion: There are 13 hostages inside the Sydney cafe

attack_plan.narrative: Several hostages have managed to escape the siege at the Lindt cafe in Sydney, creating uncertainty about the exact number of individuals still held captive. Reports indicate that multiple escapees emerged at different times, complicating the count. The siege involved multiple locations within the central business district, leading to challenges in maintaining an accurate tally of hostages. Law enforcement officials have been working tirelessly to ensure the safety of all parties involved, but the chaotic nature of the situation makes it difficult to provide a precise number of hostages. As the situation unfolds, authorities continue to assess the evolving dynamics of the event, which spans various areas around Martin Place and the surrounding streets.

posts.text: Lindt cafe siege in Sydney's CBD. Hostages seen escaping, authorities scramble.
Multiple locations involved in siege. Uncertainty about exact hostage count.
Witnesses report hostages emerging from Lindt cafe. Situation evolving.
Siege spans several blocks in Martin Place. Police under pressure to secure scene.
No one left behind in Lindt cafe. All hostages accounted for, police confirm.
Authorities emphasize safety measures and coordination efforts. Situation remains tense but under control.
